meaning:
Semi-automatic pistol (for example, Glocks) can have malfunctions from failure to eject a spent casing, or failure to feed a new round from the magazine into the chamber. These malfunctions will cause a gun to jam and not fire when expected. In a gun fight, taking the time to clear a jam can cost you your life.

Revolvers work differently. The gun does not have to cycle through the process of ejecting a spent casing and loading a new cartridge into the chamber. All of the cartridges are loaded into a cylinder, which revolves after each shot fired. The spent casings are ejected after all the rounds are fired. This makes a jam in the gun much less likely to occur unless there is a major defect within the gun, which is much less common.

Rubberized grips and other textures are often added to the handle of a pistol or revolver to make it easier to keep a good grip on the gun.
